new.title: New project
new.body: A project keeps related chats together with what they share: instructions, files, and a memory of its own.
new.name: Name

page.notFound: This project isn't here. It may have been deleted.
page.description: Chats in this project share its instructions, files, and memory.
page.name: Project name

chats.title: Chats
chats.empty: No chats in this project yet. Start one with New chat.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.hint: Every chat in this project follows these, after the profile's own. Say who the answers are for, what to focus on, or how to write.
instructions.placeholder: For example: Answers are for a small bakery. Keep them short and use metric units.

files.title: Files
files.hint: The project's chats search these files when they help answer. They stay on the Toskar computer.
files.tooBig: {{name}} is larger than {{size}}, the most a file can be.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.hint: Knowledge sources the project's chats search too, such as a folder of documents. They're linked, not copied.

folder.title: Folder
folder.hint: The project's chats work in this folder on the Toskar computer, unless a chat chooses its own. Toskar can run commands there, and asks before changing anything.
folder.label: Folder on the Toskar computer

defaults.title: Profile and model
defaults.hint: New chats in this project start with these.

memory.title: Memory
memory.hint: What the project's chats learn is remembered for its other chats, not your others. Turned off, they neither save nor read the project's memory.

delete.title: Delete project
delete.hint: Its files and what it remembered are deleted. Its chats stay in your history unless you choose to delete them too.
delete.body: Its files and what it remembered are deleted. Its chats move out of the project and stay in your history.
delete.bodyChats: Its files, what it remembered, and its chats are deleted. This can't be undone.
